summary: Vaxcyte filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) for an underwritten offering of convertible senior notes due 2032, with interest paid semi-annually each April 15 and October 15 beginning April 15, 2027. Pricing, principal amount, coupon, and initial conversion price are left blank as the deal is subject to completion; underwriters hold a 30-day over-allotment option. Notes are convertible on standard price, trading-price, corporate-event, redemption, and final-period conditions, with provisional redemption from October 22, 2029 and cleanup redemption below 10% outstanding. This is a routine financing, not a special situation; watch pricing, conversion premium, and hedging-driven equity overhang.
